info.name: Inji Certify Credential Configuration
info.description:
Add, get, update and delete the credential configurations (/credential-configurations) that the issuance flow collections use, for every format and data provider sample. Select the environment "ENV Credential Configuration" and set certifyUrl to the Certify instance.

Each sample has its own config id variable (ldpVcConfigId, preAuthLdpVcConfigId, insuranceLdpVcConfigId, sdJwtConfigId, mdlConfigId). It defaults to the sample's credentialConfigKeyId, and Add Config sets it from the response, so Get, Update and Delete work whether the configuration was added here or seeded another way.

Add the configuration a flow needs before running that flow's collection; each flow collection's description names it. Update Config samples send the full configuration, because the request is copied onto the stored configuration before it is validated. Delete soft-deletes: the configuration stops being advertised in the credential issuer metadata.

item.name: Mock Identity (MockIdaDataProviderPlugin)
item.description: MockVerifiableCredential for the mock identity use case. Certify runs in DataProvider mode with MockIdaDataProviderPlugin, which fetches the holder from the mock identity system. The plugin supplies the vcTemplate's ${UIN}, ${fullName}, ${dateOfBirth}, ${gender}, ${email}, ${phone}, ${face}, ${postalCode}, ${province} and ${region}; Certify fills ${_holderId}, ${_issuer}, ${validFrom} and ${validUntil}. Used by the "Inji Certify With Mock Identity Bearer" and "Inji Certify With Mock Identity DPoP" collections.

request.description:
MockVerifiableCredential for the mock identity use case. Certify runs in DataProvider mode with MockIdaDataProviderPlugin, which fetches the holder from the mock identity system. The plugin supplies the vcTemplate's ${UIN}, ${fullName}, ${dateOfBirth}, ${gender}, ${email}, ${phone}, ${face}, ${postalCode}, ${province} and ${region}; Certify fills ${_holderId}, ${_issuer}, ${validFrom} and ${validUntil}. Used by the "Inji Certify With Mock Identity Bearer" and "Inji Certify With Mock Identity DPoP" collections.

cryptographicBindingMethodsSupported and proofTypesSupported are mandatory: omitting either, or sending it null or empty, is rejected with invalid_request. Each is validated against what the deployment declares in mosip.certify.credential-config.* — a request can narrow that list, never exceed it — and nothing is filled in from it. A value listed more than once is stored once. signatureAlgo is mandatory too: it is the algorithm the credential is signed with, and must be declared for the signatureCryptoSuite. The credential issuer metadata advertises the signatureCryptoSuite in credential_signing_alg_values_supported, per OpenID4VCI 1.0 Appendix A.1.2.2. credentialSigningAlgValuesSupported is no longer part of the request; a request that still sends it is rejected with invalid_request as an unrecognised field.

item.name: Sunbird Insurance (SunbirdRCVCIssuancePlugin)

Certify runs in VCIssuance mode with SunbirdRCVCIssuancePlugin: Sunbird RC builds and signs the credential, so vcTemplate is empty and Certify fills no placeholders. Used by the "Inji Certify With Sunbird Insurance" collection.

item.name: Mobile Driving Licence (MockCSVDataProviderPlugin)
item.description: DrivingLicenseCredential, an ISO/IEC 18013-5 mDL (doctype org.iso.18013.5.1.mDL) with the 11 Table 5 mandatory elements. Certify runs in DataProvider mode with MockCSVDataProviderPlugin, which reads the holder's row from a CSV file. The row supplies the vcTemplate's ${givenName}, ${familyName}, ${birthDate}, ${issueDate}, ${expiryDate}, ${documentNumber}, ${portrait} (base64 or a data: URI) and ${drivingPrivileges} (a JSON array, written unquoted in the template); Certify fills ${_doctype}, ${_signed}, ${_validFrom} and ${_validUntil}. Used by the "Inji Certify With Mock Mdoc VCI" collection; the docker-compose mock-mdl profile seeds the same configuration.
